prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background for an interactive 2.5D growth desk editor
Primary request: Create an EMPTY anime-style study desk scene designed for placing independent transparent decorative items later.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet Japanese-inspired study nook, warm cream plaster wall, an empty narrow wooden wall shelf, a small empty pinboard area, a tall window at the left with soft afternoon sunlight, and a broad completely empty wooden desktop occupying the lower 42 percent of the frame. Include a simple wooden front edge at the very bottom to establish depth.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted anime background art with clean restrained ink lines, subtle watercolor texture, cinematic but calm, consistent with a premium slice-of-life anime.
Composition/framing: fixed 3:2 landscape frame, straight-on view with a gentle 2.5D top-down desk perspective; large clear wall, shelf, and desktop placement zones; no character.
Lighting/mood: soft sunlight from the left, quiet, low-saturation, cozy without yellow haze.
Color palette: warm cream, muted sage, walnut brown, dusty beige.
Constraints: EMPTY placement surfaces; no lamp, no plant, no cup, no books, no notebook, no stationery, no figurines, no clock, no storage box, no text, no logo, no UI, no watermark; perspective must remain coherent across the whole desk; suitable as a static app background.
